verdict.rationale: Unreal ships a first-party profiler in Unreal Insights, a telemetry capture and analysis suite. It also ships two documented data-oriented paths: MassEntity, a data-oriented ECS-style framework with its own debugger, and the Tasks System, an async job manager with prerequisites on the TaskGraph backend. Nanite also covers heavy scenes with high object counts. missing for 10: explicit documentation of GPU/mesh instancing (e.g. instanced static meshes), independent or hands-on corroboration of profiler and Mass performance at scale.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can profile and scale — a real profiler, plus data-oriented paths (ECS, jobs, instancing) when scenes get heavy

citations.quote: Unreal Insights is a telemetry capture and analysis suite that can capture events from your project at high data rates.
MassEntity is a gameplay-focused framework for data-oriented calculations.
Tasks System is a job manager that provides the capability to execute your gameplay code asynchronously.
render pixel scale detail and high object counts
